dslRule:
<!id: add-missing-override-public>
<!description: Adds the @Override annotation to public methods that legitimately override or implement a supertype method and currently lack the annotation. The DSL engine performs semantic validation to ensure the method actually overrides or implements a supertype method before applying the annotation.>
<!severity: HINT>
public void $name($params$)
=> @java.lang.Override public void $name($params$)
;;
summary: Adds missing @Override annotation to public methods.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
